ear_back_followup.method: Actual +X-to-center first hits, fixed Y, 0.1mm Z sampling and 1mm derivative filter; includes lower guard and upper transition.

method: First surface ray hits; vertical 0.1 mm pitch/11-sample cubic Savitzky-Golay filter; horizontal 0.25 degree pitch/9-sample filter; approximately 1 mm derivative smoothing.
limits: Selected contours and derivative estimates, not an exhaustive normal/curvature proof.
STL triangulation and smoothing window affect peak values; compare alongside identical-light renders.
No automatic aesthetic pass threshold is imposed.
visual_findings: Compared with v0.3 under matching lights, the upper-forehead joining band and upper-ear/temple ridge are visibly weaker; original overall head proportions remain.

The rejected lower-ear horizontal crease has disappeared in the final side view. Sampled Z21-29 profiles match v0.3; the new Z30-38 transition has no larger curvature peak in the examined posterior Y profiles.

Some shallow localized upper-forehead highlights remain. A narrow approximately 1mm-scale midline curvature peak is higher, while broader curvature and the 95th percentile improve; this is not uniformly perfect surface fairing.
